doc: stages/filters.voxeldownsize.rst: 'The input point cloud is divided into 3D voxels at the given cell size. For each populated voxel, either first point entering in the voxel or center of a voxel (depending on mode argument) is accepted and voxel is marked as populated. All other points entering in the same voxel are filtered out.' and 'center: Coordinates of the first point found in each voxel will be modified to be the center of the voxel.' The page does not say where the lattice sits; /app/spec/PROFILE.md 1.1 `filters.voxeldownsize`: 'the grid is anchored on the first point of the view, positioned so that point falls at the centre of its own voxel. The origin is `first - cell/2`, taken per axis from that same first point, so a coordinate `v` falls in voxel `k = floor((v - first + cell/2) / cell)` and the voxel centre that `mode: center` writes back is `first + k * cell`.' The same 216 voxels as first mode; the centre of voxel k is first + k*cell = 2k, so 0,2,4,6,8,10.
